summary: Phase 1 proxy-validation DONE (34 runs completed before the babysitter died; data intact, aggregated by main). NULL on all 4 reconstructed winnable tasks (native-store, claim-task, wt-gc, tls-local): cold passed EVERY held-out edge case, zero variance → proxy precision 0/4 (controls 3/3 correct). MECHANISM: the "transfer-robust general-infra" facts are in the model's pretraining prior (mkcert issuer-trust etc.) — memory can't add facts the model already knows. THIRD boundary condition added: knowledge must be PROJECT-LOCAL (absent from pretraining), alongside empirical ∧ external-to-artifact. Inverts Phase 0a's transfer reading: the project-local "meta" slice (12/52 ≈ 23%) is the winnable one. n=2 existence proof unchanged. bench/report-phase1.md; verdict note-mq81v6vam6c.
